invariants.open_provenance: The explicit provenance policy requires listed Programmable publication and empty fee obligations. It imposes no contract safety or economic assessment.
invariants.request_integrity: The exact bounded UTF-8 JSON request obeys this version's published grammar and commitments.
invariants.chain_binding: Every action, dependency and claim is bound to the requested supported chain.
invariants.controller_binding: Only the credential-bound controller may authorize the exact transaction.
invariants.window: The immutable validity window has a deadline strictly after validAfter.
invariants.budget: The aggregate exact action value and gas remain inside the declared budgets.
invariants.source_binding: Every declared component binds an exact compilation unit, source and constructor/runtime materialization.
invariants.runtime_binding: Declared, compiled and observed critical runtime hashes agree.
invariants.hook_permissions: Declared permission bits match the address. Legacy policy V1 also checks return-delta dependencies; open provenance relies on actual requested execution.
invariants.callback_abi: Legacy policy V1 requires enabled callbacks to have the exact selector and return shape. Open provenance does not impose callback ABI recognition.
invariants.callback_authority: Legacy policy V1 requires effectful callbacks to reject other callers. Open provenance does not assess callback authentication.
invariants.action_binding: Action references resolve to the immutable ordered graph and execution bytes.
invariants.platform_authority: Platform authority is restricted to one terminal call with the released launch_stamp target, stampPlanV1 operation, empty data and zero value; the issuer fills the bound stamp after the final controller prefix.
invariants.effect_binding: Completion effects bind their exact criticality, targets and observed values.
invariants.dependency_binding: Existing dependencies bind the exact address, runtime and authority snapshot.
invariants.fee_obligation: Legacy policy V1 applies 20 bps to declared pool paths or Programmable-routed swaps; no-swap is not_applicable. Open provenance requires no fee obligation.
invariants.execution: Exact controller transaction simulation and finalized execution preserve all bound effects.
invariants.availability: Missing analysis, adapter or provider evidence is pending and retryable, never an unsafe judgment.
invariants.manifest: The operation uses artifacts generated from the same immutable manifest digest.
invariants.idempotency: Changed bytes use a new idempotency key; retries and successor plans preserve existing immutable reservations.
invariants.distribution: Open provenance requires listed Programmable publication; legacy publication is optional. External submissions remain optional and require stored opt-in.
